tasks.analysis: Construction is the process of designing and building projects, which involve workers and machines. Construction work involves a number of different workers from construction managers, carpenters, builders, and construction workers, to masons, plasterers, electricians, and bricklayers. The process with which a construction project is completed involves several different parts. These include planning a project from start to finish, budgeting the project, planning materials, obtaining materials needed for the project, the actual construction of the project, and commissioning the final product. 建筑是涉及工人与机械的项目设计和建造过程。建筑工程涵盖众多不同工种的工人，包括施工经理、木匠、建筑工、建筑工人，以及泥瓦匠、抹灰工、电工和砌砖工等。一个建筑项目的完成过程包含多个不同环节，其中包括对项目进行从头到尾的规划、项目预算编制、材料规划、获取项目所需材料、项目的实际施工以及最终产品的验收交付。
